description.value: Royal LePage Place Arena is West Kelowna's premier multipurpose ice facility, built in 2007 with a 1,500-seat capacity and a full NHL-size ice sheet. It serves as home ice for the West Kelowna Warriors of the BC Hockey League and hosts public skating, minor hockey, figure skating, and ringette. The facility also features a free indoor walking track and can accommodate concerts and trade shows.
